subject: general
question: Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA) aims to provide useful and relevant elementary education for all children in the age group of ____ years.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 6 - 14.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA)** is a flagship program launched by the Government of India aimed at **the universalization of elementary education**.
 
• The SSA focuses on providing education to all children in the age group of **6 to 14 years**, ensuring that they receive quality education.
 
• Launch Year: Started in 2001, pioneered by Atal Bihari Vajpayee, the former Prime Minister of India.
 
• The program emphasizes the importance of free and compulsory education as mandated by the **Right to Education Act, 2009**.
 
• SSA aims to bridge gaps in access to education, improve the quality of learning, and enhance the infrastructure of schools across India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Objectives**: The primary objectives of SSA include increasing enrollment, improving retention rates, and enhancing learning outcomes for children.
 
• **Implementation**: SSA is implemented through various strategies, including the establishment of new schools, training teachers, and providing necessary learning materials.
 
• **Inclusive Education**: The program emphasizes inclusivity, aiming to provide education to marginalized and disadvantaged groups, including children with disabilities.
 
• **Monitoring and Evaluation**: The effectiveness of SSA is monitored through various assessment mechanisms, including regular audits and surveys to track progress in enrollment and learning achievements.
 
• Significance: It is the Government of India's flagship program for achieving Universalization of Elementary Education (UEE), making education a Fundamental Right as per the 86th amendment to the Constitution.
